messages:
lina.hsu: Heads-up: gw-media (acct gw-77) just busted their rate cap during an influencer drop, asking for an immediate uplift. They claim it's organic webhook fan-out.

tara.sales: customer says promo went out earlier than planned. they can pay for overage but need headroom for next 8-12h. wants 3x.

support-bot: logs attached: 2028-01-15T09:07Z - 09:15Z. summary: 2.1M requests in 8m, 6 distinct /24 subnets, avg prompt tokens 18, sudden spike at 09:08. no existing abuse flags.

lina.hsu: sample snippet: 
```
req: d1f9a3
ua: gw-hooker/3.0
ip: 18.205.33.11
prompt_tokens: 16
status: 200
```

marc.diaz: pinging fraud triage before committing. we should also consider a staged uplift and a fallback routing plan.

sam.fraud: running checks: IPs are cloud provider + several CDN edge nodes, account has normal usage history, traffic shape is consistent with fan-out scheduler but frequency high. low signal for credential stuffing.

jonah.ops: if we do uplift, ops recs: 1) short-lived uplift (<=12h) 2) enable traffic sampling 3) attach anomaly webhook to #fraud-watch 4) create canary route to smaller model for non-critical calls.

tara.sales: customer agrees to 12h interim if we can auto-rollback on anomalies. they'll sign off on overage invoice.

marc.diaz: product proposal: temporary staged uplift: 1.5x immediate, evaluate 30m, then bump to 3x for up to 12h if stable. require webhook to fraud and ops. create SUP-2028-112. also capture a backlog ticket RDW-912 "fast uplift with fraud gating".

lina.hsu: created SUP-2028-112 and notified finance for invoicing. added monitoring hooks.

sam.fraud: set detectors: if request error rate > 4% OR token entropy < 3.5 OR > 10 req/sec from same IP prefix after sampling => auto-rollback + alert.

jonah.ops: canary fallback route ready: route/gw-77 -> small-efficient (40%) and RBAC set so only support can flip.

marc.diaz: assigning RDW-912 to product PM @marc.diaz for next sprint. deliverable: standardized uplift template, fraud gating policy, and auto-rollback playbook.

tara.sales: please cc me on customer comms. need clear rollback SLA so sales can manage expectations.

lina.hsu: messaging to customer drafted: outlines staged uplift, 12h max, monitoring and rollback triggers, and invoicing. sending now.

sam.fraud: monitoring live. initial risk: moderate. will post updates in thread if anything changes.

marc.diaz: thanks all. product note: this is a recurring ask from large media customers — prioritize RDW-912 as it reduces manual ops. closing this thread after 12h window unless escalated.

lina.hsu: closing for now — will reopen if fraud triggers or customer requests extension.
